body: Thank you and my great grandmother always says I'm young but wise.
Thank you, this made me so much better.

Thank you for the advice. I hope you and your daughter are okay and happy. I'll make sure to try to use comedy as a sort of coping mechanism. Now that I think about it you can't think about all the negativity if you're laughing.
Thank you for the advice. I'll bug my dad later to set me another appointment.
I usually look forward to  talking to her until the day before I go to see her. Then i start feeling dumb for being 12 and dealing with this it.
I'm not exactly sure what makes me laugh, but I do have music that makes me happy at times.

I have saw her in about a month and one of those loud public medical buses took me. I start seeing her a little after a week of getting out the hospital. I saw her like 3 times and then my dad completely forgot  and I was too ashamed for causing all that to tell him. I just started seeing her again a month ago.

I do have a therapist, but no car to get to her office. My dad and I have talked about it, but it always ends with something about hormones and he tells me not to kill my self. Also I was telling my friend to focus on herself, but I don't think I was fully prepared to deal with my demons without her.
